changes_2025_2026.change: January 2025: maximum Reels length raised from 90 seconds to 3 minutes, and the profile grid switched from squares to vertical rectangles.
November 2025: Reels camera can record up to 20 minutes. Help Centre now states record and upload up to 20 minutes, but Reels over 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences.
December 2025: hashtags limited to 5 per post or reel (previously 30). Help Centre now says up to 5; the Graph API reference still says 30.
Help Centre now lists supported photo aspect ratios as 1.91:1 to 3:4 (1080x1440 max); the Graph API still says 4:5 to 1.91:1. Change date not stated.
From 2025-03-31 Shorts views count every start or replay with no minimum watch time.
Official Artist Channels: square or vertical videos up to 3 minutes uploaded on or after 2025-12-08 are classified as Shorts (standard channels since 2024-10-15).
Custom thumbnail guidance now recommends 3840x2160 (2160x3840 for Shorts) with up to 50 MB on desktop (2 MB on mobile). Change date not stated.

June 2025: Videos tab renamed Reels; all videos posted to Facebook (except stories and live) are shared as reels of any length or orientation. Help Centre update dated September 2025 confirms the unification.
From 2025-02-01 eligible creators can monetize Spotlight videos longer than 1 minute (unified Monetization Program).
2025-09-04: text attachments of up to 10,000 characters can be added to a post (base post limit stays 500).
No dated 2025/2026 spec change confirmed in official TikTok sources. Current Support page: record up to 10 min, upload up to 60 min; photo posts up to 35 images.
No dated 2025/2026 spec change confirmed. Current Help Center: Premium uploads up to 4 hours / 16 GB, non-Premium 140 s / 512 MB.
